### Installing

Download the file for your platform below. These builds are **not code-signed yet**, so the first launch shows a warning:

- **macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel):** download `desigma-<version>-macos.dmg`, open it and drag **desigma** to **Applications**. The first time, open it from Applications, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/desigma.app`.
- **Windows:** unzip `desigma-<version>-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` and run `desigma.exe`. In the SmartScreen dialog, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** unpack `desigma-<version>-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`, then run `./install.sh` (no sudo) or just `./desigma`.

Full instructions: [docs/install.md](https://github.com/deepfounder-ai/desigma/blob/main/docs/install.md). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
